purpose: Verified contract for exporting approved investigation results into citizen-readable reports.
privacy_rule: Only public-safe information may enter the exported report.
source_rule: Official citations must come from the resolved source/citation layer.
snapshot_rule: The exported report references an immutable answer snapshot and does not mutate it.
historical_rule: Historical answers retain their target date and applicable source/version scope.
verification_boundary: Export confirms that the report represents an approved snapshot; it does not independently re-establish the underlying legal or property facts.
